title: TerraForge
observed_goal: No executable game goal was observed in the frames; the available evidence is inconclusive. The page text says: «Shape the wild. Survive the night.»; this is only page text, and the gameplay loop was not confirmed.
observed_controls: No active controls or key list were observed in the frames; the available evidence is inconclusive.

Space, ArrowUp, w, ArrowRight and holding ArrowRight + Space for 900 milliseconds are recorded in the metadata as attempted inputs; their acceptance by the game was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
observed_core_loop: The core game loop was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; no active game frame, interaction with the world, repeated action, or outcome was recorded.
progress_feedback: Progress feedback was not observed in the frames; the available evidence is inconclusive. The page text only shows the New World, Settings and Controls options and describes selecting seed, mode and difficulty.
decisions_risk_reward: Risk/reward decisions were not observed during game execution; the available evidence is inconclusive. The New World menu options and selection of seed, mode and difficulty appear in the text/frames, but their effect or trade-off was not tested.
rewards: No rewards, resources, score, or executable upgrades was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. The official claim about gather, craft and build is only a card claim and was not confirmed through game execution.
penalties_failure: No penalty, failure, death, or cost of error was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. The phrase «Survive the night» and the claim survive the night come from the text/card, not from a direct game outcome.
outcomes_replay: No win, loss, ending, measurable outcome, or replay loop was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. capture_status is recorded as budget_timeout and completed_stages is empty.
onboarding: The opening page has a visible menu with New World, Settings and Controls; New World displays the phrase «Pick a seed, mode and difficulty», and the page says the game is single-player and that the world is automatically saved in the browser. Successful entry into the game or interactive tutorial was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
visual_audio_accessibility: The frames show a full-screen menu with a nature image, the game title, and text buttons; no meaningful visual difference between stages was observed. Sound, subtitles, accessibility settings, and interactive readability were not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
technical_clues: The metadata recorded 9 script, one stylesheet, one XHR and 82 fetch; this is only a technical loading clue and does not establish the game's architecture or logic.
Two warnings about WebGL software fallback were recorded; this is a possible rendering-environment clue, not evidence of game capability.
HTTP errors with statuses 403, 400 and a remote config fetch error were recorded; their effect on the game experience was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
canvas_inventory, engine_markers and tuning_constant_candidates are empty; therefore the engine or tuning parameters cannot be inferred from this data.
transferable_principles: Before inferring a loop, an active game frame and repetition of an action with observable feedback should be recorded.
The opening menu should present the goal and initial options clearly and distinctly from actual gameplay.
Progress feedback should be observable within gameplay itself and attributable to the player's action.
A temporal or animated change between two frames alone does not prove input acceptance or its effect.
candle_climber_relevance: For Candle Climber, only the principle that direct feedback attributable to input is necessary can be transferred; this game did not confirm any adaptable control pattern or loop.
score/rank should reflect skill only and must not provide an advantage through a purchase or wallet.
free brake, horizontal direction change or a branching path requiring new control should not be assumed or reproduced; each is only a hypothesis requiring separate testing.
do_not_copy: Do not reproduce this game's name, character, artwork, environment, stage, text, sound, brand, or assets.
Do not copy the official card's claims about gathering, crafting, building, hunting or fire arrows as definite mechanics without confirmed execution.
Do not use the main menu's appearance or its visual composition as a direct model.

evidence.claim: The load frame shows the main menu with the title TerraForge and the New World, Settings and Controls options.
The after_start frame has the same visible content as the main menu, and no active gameplay is visible in it.
The after_key_burst frame shows the main menu; no accepted effect of the key inputs was observed in it.
The after_combined_input frame shows the main menu; a frame change alone is not proof of acceptance of the combined input.
The late frame still shows the main menu, and no outcome, failure, or win is observed.
The page text provides the phrase «Shape the wild. Survive the night.» and the selection of seed, mode and difficulty.
The page describes the game as single-player and states that the world is automatically saved in the browser.
The official card claims that the survival world includes gather, craft, build, hunt, fire arrows and survive the night; this claim was not play-tested through game execution.
The presence of multiple resources, WebGL software fallback and 403/400 and remote-config errors is only a possible technical clue and does not establish game capability.

limitations: All fallback-1 frames appear identical in visual content, and the primary capture stopped with budget_timeout; completed_stages is empty, start_action is none, and no canvas or visible image of active gameplay was recorded. Therefore, this report concerns only the page/menu and explicit metadata claims. The absence of an element in the opening frame does not prove its absence from the entire game; likewise, any possible temporal change between frames cannot be attributed to input.
